newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Mobilcom bookbuilding to run March 4-6.
newsitem.headline: German Mobilcom bookbuilding to run March 4-6.

text.p: German mobile phone company MobilCom AG is to offer 640,000 common shares for sale to the public in a bookbuilding phase running March 4-6, the manager of the issue DG Bank said on Friday.
The company is taking part in the bourse's new growth stock market, or Neue Markt, which gets off the ground on March 10.

To promote the launch, MobilCom is promising investors a discount on their mobile telephone bill each year corresponding with the level of the MobilCom share on the day of its annual shareholders' meeting.
In addition, MobilCom customers will be able to call up a price for the DAX index and MobilCom shares on their mobile phones.
MobilCom had 1996 sales of around 309 million marks ($182.7 million) and a group pre-tax profit on ordinary activities of 12.1 million marks.
